statements.attributed: the observation of a strong band at 2081 cm−1 can be assigned to the stretching vibration of the C≡N group coordinated by Fe2+ and M2+
statements.quote: The observation of a strong band at 2081 cm−1 can be assigned to the stretching vibration of the C≡N group coordinated by Fe2+ and M2+, i.e., Fe2+—C≡N—M2+.[ , , , ] The vibrational bands at around 1607 and 3530 cm−1 correspond to the O—H bending modes of H2O, and the content of crystal water was determined to 7–8 wt% by thermogravimetric analysis (TGA, Figure S1c, Supporting Information).
